item.title: Around six drones swarmed US airbase in Britain, none recovered: Report
item.description: Several unidentified drones reportedly encroached upon RAF Lakenheath, a major US military airbase in Britain. Security alerts prompted US personnel to shelter in place during this incident on November 13. The drones were ultimately repelled using counter-drone technology, although none were recovered. Iranian involvement is suspected, with no confirmation on whether they carried any payload. Security at military installations remains a top priority for both US and UK authorities. Sprouts are generally planted outdoors between March and early June, meaning they were already in the ground when the UK faced a series of heatwaves and drought conditions across Wales and most of England.
